title: Discourse Markers
summary: Discourse markers signal how ideas connect — adding, contrasting, explaining cause, or concluding.

theory.markdown:
**Discourse markers** are words or phrases that organise speech and writing by showing how ideas relate to each other.

Most discourse markers stand at the **start of a sentence** (or clause), followed by a comma.

theory.title: Discourse markers by function
rows: Moreover, Furthermore, In addition, Besides, What is more
However, Nevertheless, On the other hand, In spite of this, Despite this, That said
As a result, Therefore, Consequently, Hence, For this reason
Admittedly, Even so, All the same, Granted
For example, For instance, Such as, In particular, Namely
In conclusion, To sum up, In short, Overall, In other words

items.source: The hotel was expensive. Moreover, the service was poor.
items.translation: Hotel byl drogi. Co wiecej, obsluga byla kiepska.

items.source: She studied hard. Nevertheless, she failed the exam.
items.translation: Ciezko sie uczyla. Mimo to nie zdala egzaminu.

items.source: He missed several deadlines. As a result, he lost the contract.
items.translation: Przekroczyl kilka terminow. W zwiazku z tym stracil kontrakt.

exercises.prompt: The project was late. ___, it was over budget. (addition)
He trained every day. ___, he didn't make the final team.
exercises.explanation: 'Nevertheless' introduces a surprising contrast (he trained hard, yet didn't make the team).

exercises.instruction: Rewrite using the discourse marker 'As a result'.
exercises.source: It rained all day, so the picnic was cancelled.
answers: It rained all day. As a result, the picnic was cancelled.
It rained all day. As a result the picnic was cancelled.

exercises.prompt: ___ (conclusion), renewable energy is both practical and essential for our future.

exercises.sentence: The results were disappointing. For example, sales fell across all regions.
answers: The results were disappointing. For instance, sales fell in Europe and fell by 15% in Asia.
exercises.explanation: 'For example/instance' should introduce a specific example, not just repeat the same idea.

exercises.prompt: The candidate was well qualified. ___, she had no relevant experience.
exercises.explanation: 'However' introduces a contrast with what was just said.

exercises.prompt: She didn't study at all. ___, she still managed to pass.

exercises.source: Firma zanotowala straty. W zwiazku z tym musi zwolnic pracownikow.
answers: The company made losses. As a result, it must lay off workers.
The company made losses. Therefore, it must make redundancies.
The company made losses. Consequently, it must cut staff.

exercises.prompt: The plan was risky. ___, the team decided to go ahead.
exercises.explanation: 'Admittedly' concedes a point before moving forward — acknowledging risk while still proceeding.

exercises.prompt: Many students struggle with essay writing. ___, they often use too much informal language.
exercises.hint: Giving a specific example of a general problem.

exercises.source: The new policy is expensive and it is also difficult to implement.
answers: The new policy is expensive. Furthermore, it is difficult to implement.
The new policy is expensive. Furthermore, it's difficult to implement.

exercises.prompt: Prices have risen sharply. ___, many families can no longer afford basic goods.
exercises.explanation: 'Consequently' shows the result that follows from rising prices.

exercises.prompt: Reorder to make a logical discourse-marked sentence pair.

exercises.source: Proponowane rozwiazanie ma wiele zalet. Co wiecej, jest relatywnie tanię we wdrozeniu.
answers: The proposed solution has many advantages. Moreover, it is relatively inexpensive to implement.
The proposed solution has many benefits. Furthermore, it is relatively cheap to implement.
